images.description: Abstract dark tech mesh background for subtle hero texture
images.usage: Use as a fixed background in the hero section with low opacity (10-15%) and a gradient mask fading to transparent at the bottom. Ensures it does not compete with the previewer.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure dark mode is forced. Use the specified void black #050505 background.
Use grid-cols-12 for the main app interface. The Preview Canvas should be col-span-8, and File Info col-span-4 on desktop.
For the drag-and-drop zone, implement a dotted/dashed border that glows blue on drag-over.
Data points (Memory, FPS, Size, Dimensions) MUST use JetBrains Mono (font-mono).
Implement the SVGA Convert Tools as a dense Bento Grid using 1px gaps (gap-[1px] with bg-zinc-800/50 on parent container, bg-[#0A0A0A] on children) to expose the skeleton border.
Use Lucide icons for all UI controls.
Every interactive element and key informational text MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='upload-svga-zone', data-testid='play-pause-btn', data-testid='svga-fps-stat').
Use Shadcn UI for the conversion tools, accordions, and dropdowns (device frame selection). Do not build complex interactive components from scratch.
Do NOT use pure #000000 for backgrounds; stick to the specified #050505.
Implement custom scrollbars for the assets grid with no gutter.
Write all components and files as .js or .jsx files, NOT .tsx files. You have .js files setup in the environment.
